provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Controlled sequential phenology. Starting dormant on day1, accumulate one chill unit on each day in the inclusive chill interval; other dormant days add zero. Dormancy releases at the END of the first day reaching the chill target. Beginning the following day, daily forcing=max(0,min(T,cap)-base); dormant forcing is never banked. First flowering is the first complete day whose eligible forcing reaches or exceeds the target. No within-day interpolation.
window_policy: Report day numbers one-based within the supplied window. If flowering has not occurred, report null rather than a guessed later day. No temperatures after the window are given.
scope: Stipulated chilling/forcing mechanism,not observed phenology, a calibrated species forecast or an environmental intervention.
